prose.text: The block runs the formatter and linter, the agent crate's unit suite (the classifier, the facts, the stamp merge), the root bin's unit layer, the changed integration binaries by name (`cli_verify` is in it: verify's runs change, verification-harness.md 2026-11-17; `contract_ledger_probes` and `cli_version_gate` read the stamps; `contract_lints` pins the moved override's order; `rig_rehearsal` is the V arm's rehearsal), then the whole integration and E2E layers (every stamped binary and the harness boot copy the new `measured`), then the live round for S0R and the operator pass. The release check is not run: no test-only feature, binary or fake-agent code changes (the rig and its ledger are test-only and already refused by it). Every root test that waits keeps the shared 12 s `WITHIN` under the 20 s lint; the verify-driven cases have no test-side bound, the `ci` 20 s kill being theirs (test-plan `decision/verify-driven-tests-20s-kill`), and the `verify_window_` case its moved 80 s. Verify's output feeds the harness boot, so the operator pass boots one session `screen-smoke`, reads its status and cleans it up (boot never piped, verification-harness.md 2025-09-25 addition). No mutation run (inputs#I1 item 8).

The live leg's non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of it: the install read by path and the rig's census, neither of which primes anything. A start refused for the token window is no red to fold: implement stops and says so. The live entry's `failing:` atoms read red when the line is missing, unread, or the version entry holds fewer than the 23 relied rows (step 11, «The floor»).

The remove-the-guard controls are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, not entries (validation.md check 4 (6)), each fired with `--timeout 900`, each control's entry the filtered integration entry below (it builds the workspace, so the clone holds every binary its cases spawn; testing.md 2026-11-13); «holds» means each named case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line, and a `timeout` reading is not «holds»: - `fs-trust` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs`: the classifier's `trust` arm removed (a trust row reads on   down the arms); case `verify_first_screens_read_trust_then_box_on_the_fake`. With the guard gone the subject   (verify) stamps Run A's first screen as `none`, so the case's `a: trust` fails — measured at implement. - `fs-record` — `src/cmd/verify/typed/runs.rs`: the line storing Run F's reading removed; case   `verify_first_screens_read_trust_then_box_on_the_fake`. With the guard gone Run F's word stamps `null` — measured   at implement. - `fs-boxany` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs`: the `box_any` reader's rule-row arm removed; case   `first_screen_facts_count_rows_and_any_box_literal` (fired on the agent crate's unit entry, which builds no root   binary the case needs). With the guard gone a rule row alone reads `box_any` false, so the K1 row reads as K3's —   measured at implement. - `rig-gitroot` — `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/isolate.rs`: the git-root layout step's body removed (nothing written);   case `rig_rehearsal_v_reads_the_trust_record_row_and_no_record_left`. The `git-root` word is read from the disk   (step 6), so with the guard gone the V arm's cwd holds no `.git`, the word reads `absent` and the case's   `git-root: written` fails — measured at implement. Each control's id is at most 16 characters.
